title: Jaunty Argentinian Cheese Frittata
description: A vibrant brunch frittata featuring creamy fromage blanc, grilled tomatoes, and aromatic basil, served straight from a wooden board for an authentic Argentinian touch.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and lightly oil a sliced wooden board.
Whisk the eggs, fromage blanc, salt, pepper, and olive oil in a bowl until blended.
Spread the grilled tomatoes evenly across the wooden board and pour the egg mixture over them.
Sprinkle goat cheese and fresh basil over the top.
Bake for 12 minutes, or until the edges set and the center is slightly firm.
Remove the board from the oven and let rest for 2 minutes to firm up.
Slice into wedges and serve warm straight from the wooden board.
Garnish with extra basil leaves if desired.
